author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
Junglebop is an Icarus map where you fight others to the death as a TDM.. but you can fly! Not much special about it, but I believe funky has confirmed this as a new gamemode. This was originally made because me and funky were on rendezvous 2 and somehow we had a flying glitch with slimes behind us. Stuffs are below!
